articles.summary: WASHINGTON, D.C. and CHARLESTON, WV-- United Bankshares, Inc. (“United”) (NASDAQ: UBSI) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a fourth quarter dividend of $0.38 per share for shareholders of record as of December 11, 2026. Dividends per share of $1.52 for the year 2026 represents an increase over the $1.49 per share paid for the year of 2025.
articles.title: 53rd Consecutive Year of Dividend Increases for United Bankshares, Inc.

articles.summary: ATLANTA and ATHENS, GA—For the sixth consecutive year, the University of Georgia Athletic Association and United Bankshares are recognizing former athletes who have transitioned from the field of play to become leaders in the world of business. Former UGA volleyball and basketball player Maria Taylor (’09) is this year's Arch Award recipient, joining a host of former UGA athletes honored in past years.
articles.title: United Bankshares and the University of Georgia Athletic Association are Proud to Announce the Winner of the 2026 Arch Award
